analysisTab.analysis.changes.are.not.sav: 分析修改尚未保存。在本次浏览期间保留修改并切换方案？
Analysis changes are not saved. Keep changes for this browser session and switch versions?
analysisTab.target.sale.price.and.purcha: 目标售价与买入价已更新，
Target sale price and purchase price updated;
analysisTab.no.analysis.yet.known.valuat: 还没有算过账。系统会用已知数据（估值、挂牌价、房产税、面积）和行业默认值预填一份，你只需要改动你更清楚的数字。
No analysis yet. Known valuation, list price, property tax, area, and industry defaults will prefill a version. Update the inputs you know better.
analysisTab.inputs.remain.in.this.browse: 输入在本次浏览期间保留；离开再返回可继续保存，刷新前请先重试。
Inputs remain in this browser session, including when you leave and return. Retry saving before refreshing.
analysisTab.changing.inputs.recalculates: 修改数字后自动重算。预填字段保留来源，采用前请核实。
Changing inputs recalculates results. Prefilled fields retain their sources; verify before adopting them.
analysisTab.wait.for.the.analysis.to.sav: 请先等待分析保存成功，再应用到项目。
Wait for the analysis to save before applying it to the project.
analysisTab.cash.returned.after.loan.pay: 卖出还清贷款后拿回的现金 ÷ 现金投入
Cash returned after loan payoff ÷ cash invested
analysisTab.acquisition.holding.renovati: 买入 + 持有 + 装修 + 卖出
analysisTab.all.cash.purchase.charges.re: 全款：买入 + 杂费 + 装修 + 持有
All cash: purchase + charges + renovation + holding
analysisTab.taxes.insurance.utilities.ho: Taxes, insurance, utilities, HOA fees, etc.
analysisTab.finance.the.purchase.monthly: 用贷款买（月供自动计入持有成本）
Finance the purchase (monthly payments included in holding cash flow)
analysisTab.is.not.a.cost.it.reduces.the: 不计成本（卖出时从贷款余额
is not a cost (it reduces the loan balance
analysisTab.selling.cost.commission.sell: 卖出比例 %（佣金 + 卖方过户）
analysisTab.expected.after.repair.sale.p: 修好后能卖多少。来自估值或你定的目标售价。
Expected after-repair sale price, from valuation or your target price.
analysisTab.adjust.target.return.on.tota: 拖目标利润率（利润 ÷ 总成本），算出最多能出多少钱。
Adjust target return on total cost (profit ÷ total cost) to calculate the maximum offer.
analysisTab.the.gray.background.marks.th: 灰底是目标利润率下的最高出价，条是当前买入价，超出上限的那段画红；细刻度是 70% 法则参考。
The gray background marks the maximum offer at the target return on total cost; the bar is the current purchase price, with any excess in red. The thin marker is the 70% rule reference.
analysisTab.the.bar.shows.cost.compositi: 一根条看成本构成，竖线是售价：条比线短就有利润。
The bar shows cost composition; the line is sale price. A shorter cost bar indicates profit.
analysisTab.set.project.target.sale.pric: 把售价写为项目目标售价，买入价写为项目买入价
Set project target sale price and purchase price from this analysis
analysisTab.how.to.apply.renovation.line: 装修明细如何进入预算项
How to apply renovation line items to the budget
analysisTab.keep.existing.budget.lines.a: 保留现有预算项，按类别追加
Keep existing budget lines and append by category
analysisTab.this.converts.a.pre.purchase: 这一步把“买前估算”变成“买后预算”，以后实际支出对着它记，就能看出估算准不准。
This converts a pre-purchase estimate into the post-purchase budget. Record actual expenses against it to evaluate estimate accuracy.
